statements.quote: Given the strong demand for our products, coupled with our ability to successfully execute on our planned capacity expansion, we are also raising our multi-year outlook for Data Center sales to 50 to 70 percent annual growth for the next two years, putting us solidly ahead of our $2 billion revenue target for fiscal year 2028.
statements.notes: $2 billion is the Data Center revenue target; company expects to be 'solidly ahead' of it, so it is a floor, not a point estimate. Also guides 50-70% annual Data Center sales growth for the next two years (a growth rate, not an amount or share).

statements.quote: This confidence is anchored in the exceptional growth of our Data Centers business, where we now expect revenue to increase by more than 70 percent year-over-year.
statements.notes: Data Center revenue growth of more than 70% expected for the current year (fiscal 2026 per context); a growth rate, not a share of revenue or an amount, so qualitative. The sentence names no year.

statements.quote: Data center sales increased 78 percent from the prior year, and HVAC Technologies sales increased 48 percent, including $42.8 million of incremental sales from acquired businesses.
statements.notes: Third-quarter Data Center sales growth rate; no data center sales amount or share of revenue stated.

statements.quote: Sales growth was driven by higher sales in the Climate Solutions segment, driven by strong demand from data center customers and sales from acquired businesses.
statements.notes: Total net sales growth (Q3 net sales of $805.0 million) attributed in part to data center demand.

statements.quote: This decrease was due to an increase in working capital, primarily related to higher inventory balances and higher capital expenditures to support growth in Data Centers.
statements.notes: Capex is for manufacturing capacity for Modine's Data Center (cooling) product line, which serves data-center demand, not AI compute capex. Covers the nine months ended December 31, 2025. Total capex figures (YTD $101M; FY26 outlook $150M-$180M, p08) are not linked to data centers in their own sentences.

statements.quote: SG&A lower 220 bps; dollar increase driven by CS acquisitions and data center growth investment, partially offset by PT cost savings initiatives
statements.notes: Bullet fragment, not a full sentence. Q3 SG&A ($89.3M) increase attributed in part to investment in data center product growth, not AI spend as such.
